name: ApiEndpoint
description: Mortar documentation api endpoint, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 2); the parameters heading sits one level below

contract.usage: Import { ApiEndpoint } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
